name: cheshi-desktop
description: A desktop workspace for AI-assisted development with Codex, CodeGraph, terminals, and Git.

scripts.build: bun run codegraph:build && bun run viewer:build
scripts.check: bun run desktop:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.desktop:check: bun run desktop:preload && node --check desktop/bootstrap.mts && node --check desktop/main.mts && node --check desktop/runtime/preload.cjs && node --check forge.config.mts && bun run desktop:typecheck && bun run codegraph:server:typecheck
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run desktop:ghostty && bun run scripts/start-desktop-dev.mts
scripts.desktop:make: bun run desktop:ghostty && bun run viewer:build && bun run desktop:runtime && electron-forge make
scripts.desktop:package: bun run desktop:ghostty && bun run viewer:build && bun run desktop:runtime && electron-forge package
scripts.desktop:test:workspace-manager-bridge: bun run desktop:preload && bun run viewer:build && node --test desktop/test/workspace-manager-electron-bridge.test.ts
scripts.desktop:test: bun run desktop:preload && node --test desktop/test/account-usage-preload.test.ts desktop/test/about-page.test.ts desktop/test/about-window.test.ts
